Rutaceae.key_door: pellucid oil glands + floral disk; fruit split into Ptelea samara, Zanthoxylum follicle, Thamnosma 2-lobed capsule

Meliaceae.key_door: Melia: 2–3-pinnate leaf + staminal tube + yellow drupe; introduced comparison

Simaroubaceae.key_door: Ailanthus: huge pinnate leaf + basal glandular leaflet teeth + dense winged fruits; introduced comparison

taxonomy_notes: Zanthoxylum hirsutum is source provenance for accepted Zanthoxylum clava-herculis subsp. fruticosum under current Kew/FNA.
Ptelea trifoliata and Thamnosma texana remain accepted current species.
Melia azedarach remains accepted but is native to Asia/Australia and introduced in North America.
Ailanthus altissima remains accepted but is native to China/Taiwan and introduced broadly elsewhere.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Do not use odor/crushing as a required ID test.
Melia and Ailanthus are comparison families, not native Central Texas anchors.
